metadata.case_name: BHIM BAHADUR RAI v. FUNG SHING HONG, HONG KONG (A FIRM)

plaintiff.occupation_before: temporary worker (operating a vertical baling press) in the defendant's factory
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: security guard, a messenger, a delivery worker of light goods, a cleaner, chauffeur (could learn to drive)

injuries.description: He had a large, ragged wound on the palm and the back of the lateral half of the right hand. The tendons and bones were exposed. The wound was bleeding actively.
source: He had a large, ragged wound on the palm and the back of the lateral half of the right hand. The tendons and bones were exposed. The wound was bleeding actively.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of other parts of wrist or hand

injuries.description: He had a 20 cm laceration in the forearm extending to the palm and another 10 cm C-shaped laceration in the hand.
source: He had a 20 cm laceration in the forearm extending to the palm and another 10 cm C-shaped laceration in the hand.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of wrist or hand

injuries.description: The median and outer nerves were crushed.
source: The median and outer nerves were crushed.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at forearm level

injuries.description: The flexor digitorum superficialis of the second, fourth and fifth digits were ruptured and crushed.
source: The flexor digitorum superficialis of the second, fourth and fifth digits were ruptured and crushed.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple flexor muscles or tendons at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: His flexor pollicis longus was completely ruptured.
source: His flexor pollicis longus was completely ruptured.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of long flexor muscle, fascia or tendon of thumb at wrist or hand level

source: He was admitted to the hospital for the third time on 16 December 2005 for seven days for antibiotic treatment to the wound infection.

manifestations.description: He now has five scars on the right hand.
The plaintiff still complains of residual symptoms of the fingers and thumb and wrist of the right hand and weakness in the right hand.
There was some decrease in flexion range of the fingers of the right hand and mild decrease of end-range movement of the right wrist.
After the tendon transfer, there is weakness in flexion of the right thumb and decrease in the end-range of extension of the right thumb.
He cannot perform a full empty grip of the right hand when not holding objects; he can make a reasonable grip if an object is placed in the palm.
Main residual problem is weakness in handling heavy objects and performing strenuous pushing and pulling movements, especially in prolonged and repetitive manner.
There was, however, no definite fracture.

treatments_received: transfer of the flexor pollicis longus to another tendon (tendon transfer)
flap coverage of the palm skin on 2 November 2005

losses.description: He now has five scars on the right hand.

Reduced function of the right hand: decreased flexion/extension, weakness in grip and in flexion of the right thumb; inability to perform a full empty grip and weakness in handling heavy objects and prolonged/repetitive pushing and pulling.
He could not go back to his pre-accident job which required repetitive lifting of heavy objects.
